# pulsar Provider

Manage Apache Pulsar clusters, tenants, namespaces, topics, functions, connectors, and related resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pulsar = {
      source = "streamnative/pulsar"
    }
  }
}

provider "pulsar" {
  web_service_url = "http://localhost:8080"
}
```

## Upgrading to v0.14

Function, sink, and source configuration fields may contain credentials, but the provider does not mark these generic fields as sensitive automatically. This preserves compatibility for existing outputs and expressions whose configurations contain only non-secret values.

Use a sensitive variable when a configuration contains secrets:

```terraform
variable "function_user_config" {
  type      = map(string)
  sensitive = true
}

resource "pulsar_function" "example" {
  # ...
  user_config = var.function_user_config
}
```

For inline values, use `sensitive({...})`. Terraform then propagates the sensitive marking to plans and dependent expressions. Outputs exposing the value must set `sensitive = true`; use `nonsensitive()` only when disclosure is intentional. Sensitive values may still be stored in plaintext state; protect state storage and access.

When upgrading existing `pulsar_sink` state with `-refresh=false`, some Terraform versions may show a one-time in-place change while recording the new resource schema version. This is a state-only migration and does not call Pulsar APIs. A normal refreshed plan, and subsequent `-refresh=false` plans after the migration, are clean.

## Schema

### Optional

- `api_version` (String) Pulsar admin API version. `0` selects the provider default.
- `audience` (String) The OAuth 2.0 resource server identifier for the Pulsar cluster
- `client_id` (String) The OAuth 2.0 client identifier
- `issuer_url` (String) The OAuth 2.0 URL of the authentication provider which allows the Pulsar client to obtain an access token
- `key_file_path` (String) The path of the private key file
- `scope` (String) The OAuth 2.0 scope(s) to request
- `tls_allow_insecure_connection` (Boolean) Disables TLS certificate verification; use only for testing.
- `tls_cert_file_path` (String) Path to the cert to use when using TLS client authentication
- `tls_key_file_path` (String) Path to the key to use when using TLS client authentication
- `tls_trust_certs_file_path` (String) Path to a custom trusted TLS certificate file
- `token` (String) Bearer token for Pulsar authentication.
- `web_service_url` (String) Pulsar admin REST endpoint. Defaults to `http://localhost:8080`.
